context.transcript:
Corkmas department stores just agreed to carry our line of perfumes.
Wow!
That means our perfumes are going to be in a lot of new markets.
This is the perfect time to order shopping bags with our new company logo.
That way Corkmas will have them to use when they start carrying our perfumes.
Here are the logo designs I'm working on.
Take a look.
The one with the ribbon is perfect.
It looks like a little gift box.
context.transcript_translation:
Corkmas百货商店刚刚同意携带我们的香水系列。
哇！
这意味着我们的香水将进入许多新的市场。
现在是订购带有我们新公司标志购物袋的完美时机。
这样Corkmas在开始销售我们的香水时就能使用它们了。
这是我正在设计的标志。请看。
带丝带的那一个很完美。
它看起来像一个小礼盒。
